title: (To-be-deprecated) Get recommended bids
content_data:
> **Important**
> This endpoint will be deprecated in the next API version. We recommend that you migrate to [/tool/diagnosis/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738674986981378) and obtain the bid estimated delivery results through the response parameter `bid_edr_info`. Use this endpoint to get 9 sets of recommended bids and the corresponding estimated cost data for each bid on the same day when the bid is adopted. If you want to get a suggested bid value for your ad group based on basic campaign and ad group settings, see [Get suggested bid]( https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737107845597186). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/delivery/bid/recommend/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| | advertiser_id {required} |string| Advertiser ID. | | adgroup_ids {required} | string[] | Ad group IDs. The number of IDs cannot exceed 20. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/delivery/bid/recommend/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&adgroup_ids=["{{adgroup_id}}"]' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{35%}|Data Type{10%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number| Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string| Response message. For details, see [Appendix-Return codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |request_id |string| The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object| Returned data. | #| results |object[] | List of ad group IDs and corresponding bid recommendation results.| ##| adgroup_id | string | Ad group ID. | ##| recommendations | object[] | 9 sets of data for recommended bid raise ratios from -10% to 30% with a step of 5% and corresponding estimated results.| ###| recommended_bid | float | Recommended bid. Please adopt one suitable bid using [/adgroup/update/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739586761631745) and pass the adopted bid price to `conversion_bid_price` within the same day (advertiser account time zone). | ###| bid_increase_ratio | float | Estimated bid raise ratio. | ###| estimated_cost | float | Estimated cost. | ###| cost_uplift | float | Estimated cost uplift. | ###| cost_uplift_ratio | float | Estimated cost uplift ratio. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "results": [ { "recommendations": [ { "cost_uplift_ratio": 0.83, "estimated_cost": 553.43, "recommended_bid": 0.63, "bid_increase_ratio": 0.25, "cost_uplift": 251.4 }, { "cost_uplift_ratio": 0.47, "estimated_cost": 444.8, "recommended_bid": 0.57, "bid_increase_ratio": 0.15, "cost_uplift": 142.36 }, { "cost_uplift_ratio": -0.14, "estimated_cost": 261.17, "recommended_bid": 0.48, "bid_increase_ratio": -0.05, "cost_uplift": -42.4 }, { "cost_uplift_ratio": -0.27, "estimated_cost": 222.25, "recommended_bid": 0.45, "bid_increase_ratio": -0.1, "cost_uplift": -81.78 }, { "cost_uplift_ratio": 0.0, "estimated_cost": 302.89, "recommended_bid": 0.5, "bid_increase_ratio": 0.0, "cost_uplift": 0 }, { "cost_uplift_ratio": 0.15, "estimated_cost": 347.4, "recommended_bid": 0.53, "bid_increase_ratio": 0.05, "cost_uplift": 45.43 }, { "cost_uplift_ratio": 1.02, "estimated_cost": 611.93, "recommended_bid": 0.65, "bid_increase_ratio": 0.3, "cost_uplift": 308.95 }, { "cost_uplift_ratio": 0.64, "estimated_cost": 497.73, "recommended_bid": 0.6, "bid_increase_ratio": 0.2, "cost_uplift": 193.85 }, { "cost_uplift_ratio": 0.3, "estimated_cost": 394.72, "recommended_bid": 0.55, "bid_increase_ratio": 0.1, "cost_uplift": 90.87 } ], "adgroup_id": "adgroup_id" } ] } } (/code) ```
